'''Dreeson''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was stationed in the [[Aurek Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[3642 BBY]].
